notes: Every visual component in kit/hf, generated by kit/hf/tools/registry.py from the module headers (do not hand-edit: document the call in the module's header and add its META line, then --write). 'explains' uses the types in kit/refs/SCENES.md §2; 'looks' = the module's home look + every look a film has used it in ('used_in'); 'match'/'needs' are how kit/qa/precheck.mjs counts it in a film's script; 'timing' is seconds on screen. Short-form templates live in kit/graphics/<id>/meta.json with the same fields.
